quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Announces Positive Topline Results (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive topline results from the planned interim analysis of the randomized Phase 3 ACTION-1 trial, run by subsidiary RayzeBio: RYZ101 (225Ac-DOTATATE), an actinium-based radiopharmaceutical therapy, versus investigator's choice of standard of care in SSTR+ gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) that progressed after Lutetium-177-based therapy met the primary endpoint with a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival by blinded independent central review, with safety consistent with the known RYZ101 profile; patients will be followed for overall survival. The FDA granted RYZ101 Orphan Drug Designation for GEP-NETs in August 2026, and RayzeBio plans to engage with the FDA on next steps toward a regulatory submission; detailed results are to be presented at a future medical meeting. RayzeBio CMO Amreen Husain: these are the first results from a Phase 3 trial of an alpha-isotope based targeted RPT (225Ac) in any indication.
quarterly_data.figure: Phase 3 ACTION-1 met its PFS primary endpoint; Orphan Drug Designation August 2026
